name: Familiar Bluet
desc: Familiar Bluet (Enallagma civile): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The familiar bluet is a narrow-winged damselfly of the family Coenagrionidae, which is native to much of the United States and southern Canada. In a broader sense, it is a part of the order Odonata.
